[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an '''H-type Nubian yacht''' to [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|negotiations]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]<ref name="Bombad Jedi" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|yacht]] was destroyed in an accident, courtesy of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="Bombad Jedi" />
